markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (99%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class set and second-model agreement support this [F1], but neighbors lean Invasive.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 99%, Invasive 1% | Clearly dominant |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / percentile 0.96 | Flag not raised |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Weak; 3 are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Sparse benign stroma/fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score is linked to invasive in the concept model · Validated
- **Gland/tubule formation** (regions 5, 6, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score is linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Duct-confined atypical cells** (regions 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Fits an in situ pattern · Weak
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low score is linked to lower invasive likelihood · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Largest term, but failed spot check (0/20) · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47 to 0.60), so it is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002), so not shown to reflect the classifier; normal lobules is Unreliable (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- JPEG degradation (severity 3) distorts features; the 99% may overstate certainty.
- Regions 2 and 9 hold true invasion; their per-region invasive risk is 74% and 75%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 9** — highest invasive risk (74%, 75%); look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 4, 10** — confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts (concept spot check 12/20).
3. **Region 11** — sparse stroma/fat and lobule score failed checks; verify tissue type.
